Apple has just released the fourth developer beta of iOS 27, build 23G71. iOS 27 beta 4 replaces the third beta of iOS 27, which had two releases, continuing Apple's beta cycle this summer in preparation for the fall launch. We'll be updating our devices and sharing what we find.

Apple releases fourth iOS 27 developer beta for testing

The fourth developer beta is now available via the Settings app on eligible iPhones. If you're signed up for the Apple Developer Program, head to Settings > General > Software Update > Beta Updates and choose the iOS 27 Developer Beta.

Apple launched the first iOS 27 public beta on July 13, and the build released today is expected to become iOS 27 public beta 2 next week. The final version for all users will arrive this fall.

As always, developer betas may still contain bugs, reduced battery life, app compatibility issues, and other rough edges, so keep that in mind.

iOS 27 centers on Siri AI

iOS 27 is one of Apple's most AI-focused iPhone updates to date, with the biggest spotlight on Siri AI — a rebuilt assistant powered by the next generation of Apple Intelligence and new Apple Foundation Models.

Siri AI delivers richer conversational experience, personalized context, broader world knowledge, on-screen awareness, and deeper system-wide actions across apps.

On iPhone, Siri AI also gets a new visual experience that fits with Dynamic Island, plus a dedicated Siri app so you can browse your conversation history across devices.

Visual Intelligence also joins Siri, including a new Siri mode in the Camera app and changes to how the iPhone camera controls work.

Apple Intelligence is also expanding to more apps. iOS 27 brings AI-driven improvements to Photos, Safari, Passwords, Mail, Messages, Phone, Shortcuts, Home, and more. As we noted in our teardown of Apple's next-gen Foundation Models, some features will run on-device while others will use Private Cloud Compute.

Not every iPhone gets every AI feature in iOS 27. iOS 27 itself supports iPhone 11 and later, as well as iPhone SE (2nd generation) or newer, but Siri AI needs newer, Apple Intelligence-capable hardware. Apple's most powerful on-device AI models have even stricter hardware requirements, including iPhone 17 Pro and iPhone Air.

More iOS 27 features and changes

Beyond Siri and Apple Intelligence, iOS 27 includes a number of iPhone-specific changes. Apple has refined last year's Liquid Glass design, including adding a Liquid Glass transparency slider for adjusting the look of the system interface.

There are also performance improvements to app launching, Photos loading, opening the camera in Low Power Mode, AirDrop transfers, and switching between Wi-Fi and cellular.

Other iPhone changes include keyword and star rating support in Photos, customizable slideshows, smoother camera operation, continuous message sending in Messages, dual-camera simultaneous recording in FaceTime, custom EQ for AirPods, new recovery options, easier Apple Pay card switching, and AI-generated wallpaper creation.

We're installing iOS 27 beta 4 and will update with anything noteworthy. In the meantime, you can revisit everything new in iOS 27 through Apple's keynote roundup.
